entities.summary: Blake Daniel Geoffrion is an American former professional ice hockey player. He played in the National Hockey League with the Nashville Predators and Montreal Canadiens between 2011 and 2012. He was selected in the second round, 56th overall, by the Predators in the 2006 NHL entry draft and made his NHL debut on February 26, 2011. In doing so, he became the first fourth-generation player in the league's history, after his father Dan, grandfather Bernie and great-grandfather Howie Morenz.
